    Add a transpilation pass that runs before any other passes, to convert an AST containing ES6 features into one that only contains ES3 features, if the language_in is ES6 and the language_out is ES3 or ES5.

    Add a transpilation pass that runs before any other passes, to convert an AST containing ES6 features into one that only contains ES3 features, if the language_in is ES6 and the language_out is ES3 or ES5.

    So far, this just converts extended object literals ({a, b}) to ES3 object literals ({a: a, b: b}).
    
    See issue #406.
